extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: v1.5.4 (2026-10-09) - Cold boot VPN connect waits past system startup - PIA configs are written in one safe step half written files can no longer break connects - Mullvad update failures no longer kill the monitor service they retry next cycle - Mullvad and NordVPN fail over to another server in the same country with a stop guard after repeated tries - A dead server can no longer show as connected traffic is verified first - Failover notifications show the server actually used and its exit IP - Fixed kill switch false error on every connect the result was passed on wrong - Fixed connect loop when opening a mapped addon the monitor sees the connection and stops switching forever - Fixed DNS copied from the wrong server after connecting - Custom configs import from a whole folder with a progress screen names are kept addon backups accepted too - Connect and disconnect notifications show reliably - DNS leak test and network reset show progress and can be cancelled - All screens use one shared dialog layer for a consistent look - Kill switch now detects the local network live from the system - All fixed storage paths are gone locations follow the real install - Fixed Mullvad servers with special name characters Sweden is back - Fixed PIA country selection on menu update passwords handled safe everywhere - Fixed server menu names losing letters in rare cases - Background PIA notices no longer disturb other addon tasks
